metadata.rounding_rule: ROUND_HALF_UP to 0.001: coordinates first, Euclidean travel times from rounded coordinates second, service durations third; facility opening costs recomputed from final travel times

facility_cost_metadata.formula: f_i = base_cost * (1 + heterogeneity * (2*a_i - 1)); a_i = (max_h dbar_h - dbar_i) / (max_h dbar_h - min_h dbar_h); dbar_i = mean_j d_ij over customers j; closer to customers (lower dbar_i) => higher a_i => higher f_i
